content.title: Is the Stock Market Open?
content.text: Tomorrow, Thursday, April 16, 2026, the stock market will be open. Applies to US Stock Markets including the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and NASDAQ. This information is based on the time in New York (-04:00). The page will refresh every 15 minutes in order to stay up-to-date. Frequently Asked Questions What time does the stock market open? The NYSE and NASDAQ are open Monday-Friday 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time. There are 10 trading holidays when markets are closed plus several scheduled half-days. On half-days markets closed early at 1:00 p.m. Pre-market trading is 6:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and after-hours trading is 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. Is the stock market open on July 3rd? The stock market is sometimes closed on July 3rd and sometimes it is a half-day. If July 4th falls on a Saturday, then the stock market will be closed on the 3rd (Friday). If July 4th is a Sunday, then the stock market will be closed on the 5th (Monday). If July 4th is Tuesday - Friday, then the previous day, July 3rd, will be a half-day. Is the stock market open on MLK Day? No, the NYSE and NASDAQ are closed on Martin Luther King, Jr. Day. MLK day is on the third Monday of January each year. Is the stock market open on Black Friday? Black Friday, the day after Thanksgiving, is always a half-day. Thanksgiving is always a Thursday so the following Friday will always be a half-day. Is the stock market open on Labor Day? No, the US Markets are closed on Labor Day. In the US, Labor day is the first Monday of September each year. Is the stock market open on Sunday? US markets are open Monday-Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday. In some countries, the stock market is open on Saturday or Sunday in some cases. For example, the Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange in Israel is open Sunday to Thursday. Global Markets - Wednesday, April 15, 2026 An account is required to continue browsing.
